takeaways.label: A focused first release
takeaways.text: The team agreed to launch the refreshed homepage and signup flow first. The resource library will follow once the core experience is live.

takeaways.label: Quality before the date
takeaways.text: Friday remains the target, provided the mobile review and accessibility checks are complete. The team will make the final call on Thursday.

actions.label: Maya
actions.text: Share the final homepage copy by Wednesday afternoon so design and engineering can finish their review.

actions.label: Alex
actions.text: Check the signup flow on mobile and bring any unresolved issues to Thursday’s launch review.

items.label: Make the next step clear
items.text: The homepage should explain who the product is for and guide visitors toward signup. The team preferred a shorter page with concrete examples.

items.label: Keep room for follow-up
items.text: The resource library is useful but does not need to block the first release. Its timeline will be decided after launch feedback is reviewed.

openQuestions.label: Launch timing
openQuestions.text: Will Thursday’s review leave enough time to resolve any remaining mobile issues before Friday?
